exclude.reason: Pointer to a separately managed skill (~/.omp/agent/managed-skills/ui-ux-pro-max-skill); its 1.9 MB CSV dataset is vendored under data/, the pointer itself is not a loadable skill.

Upstream OMP extension hardcodes ~/.omp paths, mutates mcp.json, and enforces a deny-by-default 12-skill gate that would fight Studio orchestration. Studio adopts the designer's content and validators instead.
Upstream Pi extension; superseded by Studio's host-aware orchestrator.
Runtime gate for the upstream extension above; unused once that extension is not loaded.

notes: extensions/index.js is vendored for its exported helpers only (resolveAuditCss, formatAuditResult). Studio never calls the upstream extension factory — Studio owns orchestration and mode state.
extensions/package.json is vendored because it carries the "type": "module" marker the upstream extension needs; without it Node re-parses the file on every load.
